items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: At that time Alvin Alcorn was playing with the band and my brother was playing with the band.

ctx.x: No, this guy was named K-A-T-O, Kato. Well anyhow, Sidney hired a couple of these real good piano players and Sidney was very strict. You had to play his music as is, you know. You don't put no rest. They wanted to be hot, so he had to fire them. I don't know how he'd become the high of me, but anyhow, I wasn't that good a musician. At that time Alvin Alcorn was playing with the band and my brother was playing with the band.
All real top musicians, you know.
